No word article is added: 21 existing articles each gain one link to a new card. A card quizzes each reading that a declaring word article uses, unless the pinned JMdict marks the spelling as ateji or the reading as gikun; name-only readings are never quizzed; a reading type with no such reading gets an empty quizzed list. All fifteen pass, so none is set aside.
